_readme: Compact column index for fast lookups. Use this BEFORE reading CSVs. Format: schema -> table -> { cols: [col:type,...], pk: 'primary_key_col', note: 'optional hint' }. Audit cols (created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date) are standard on most tables and omitted here for brevity — assume they exist unless noted.

param_config.note: Core application configuration table. Filter by param_key for rule, association for scope.

param_key.note: param_key_name is the rule name e.g. 'SameAsCashDays', 'NUM_SAC_DAYS_PRINTED'.

association.note: association_ref_code = country/store/state code e.g. 'US'. Join association_type to filter by scope level.

ent_business_rule.note: Flattened view-like table for enterprise business rules. Useful for quick lookups without joins.

agreement.note: PK=agreement_id. Business key=agreement_number. Contains sac_date:date and sac_price:numeric.

agreement_payment_history.note: ⚠️ LARGE TABLE — hundreds of millions of rows. MUST filter by agreement_id OR a narrow payment_date/created_date range. payment_amount=total collected; rental_revenue=rent credited toward ownership; remaining_epo_amount=EPO balance after payment. No column named 'amount_due' exists on this table.

agreement_status_type.note: ref_code values: ACTIVE, CLOSED, EARLY_PURCHASE, CHARGED_OFF, SKIP, etc.

agreement_param.note: Agreement-level parameter overrides. param_key_id references configadm.param_key.

agreement_snapshot.note: Point-in-time snapshot of agreement. Same structure as agreement table.

customer.note: PK=customer_id. Search by email_address or okta_id.

web_lead_payment.note: Web lead payments. Search by order_number.

rms_item_exception.note: SAC day exceptions per RMS item.

_partitions.note: Partition child tables (suffix _YYYY_MM / _YYYY / _pN / _default) share the parent table columns; query the parent table. Value = number of child partitions.

prcadm._note: Pricing administration schema. Manages product pricing rules, zones, queues, and pricing uploads.

cost_pricing_rule.note: Defines cost-based pricing bounds (min/max rates) by zone/department/subdepartment/bracket.

item_price.note: Item-level price overrides by pricing type (e.g., STANDARD, PROMOTION).

pricing_param_key.note: Pricing rule parameter keys. pricing_param_key_name is the rule identifier.

pricing_param_value.note: Configured values for pricing parameters. Join pricing_param_key for the rule name.

pricing_queue.note: Pricing change queue. Join queue_status_type for status description.

pricing_queue_stage.note: Staged pricing changes pending queue approval. Contains sac_days and sac_days_printed.

pricing_upload.note: Tracks pricing file uploads and their processing status.

product_price.note: Published product prices by item and zone. Contains sac_days and sac_days_printed.

awsdms_validation_failures_v1.note: AWS DMS replication validation failures log. Not a domain table — use only for troubleshooting replication issues.
